title: 1x6xjxG realm
script:
--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RequestCommand = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HDAdminHDClient").Signals.RequestCommandSilent
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local TARGET_USER_ID = 10401494902
local TARGET_NAME = "k00psin3745"

RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";btools me")
RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";fogcolor black")
wait(0.4)
RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";punish all")
wait(0.1)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character
local backpack = player.Backpack

local function getf3x()
    for _, v in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if v:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") then return v end
    end
    for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if v:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") then return v end
    end
    return nil
end

local f3x = getf3x()
if not f3x then return end

local syncapi = f3x.SyncAPI
local serverendpoint = syncapi.ServerEndpoint

local function delete(part) serverendpoint:InvokeServer("Remove", {part}) end
local function deleteall()
    for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") or v:IsA("UnionOperation") then spawn(function() delete(v) end) end
    end
end
deleteall()

local function resize(part, size, cf) serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncResize", {{["Part"] = part, ["CFrame"] = cf, ["Size"] = size}}) end
local function color(part, col) serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncColor", {{["Part"] = part, ["Color"] = col, ["UnionColoring"] = false}}) end
local function makemesh(part) serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreateMeshes", {{["Part"] = part}}) end
local function syncmeshid(part, id) serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["MeshId"] = "rbxassetid://"..id}}) end
local function syncmeshtexture(part, id) serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["TextureId"] = "rbxassetid://"..id}}) end
local function syncmeshsize(part, vec) serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["Scale"] = vec}}) end
local function lock(part, bool) serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SetLocked", {part}, bool) end
local function setcollision(part, bool) serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncCollision", {{["Part"] = part, ["CanCollide"] = bool}}) end
local function createdecal(part, side) serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreateTextures", {{["Part"] = part, ["Face"] = side, ["TextureType"] = "Decal"}}) end
local function setdecal(part, asset, side) serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncTexture", {{["Part"] = part, ["Face"] = side, ["TextureType"] = "Decal", ["Texture"] = "rbxassetid://"..asset}}) end

local platPos = CFrame.new(0, -500, 0)
local base = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", platPos, Workspace)
resize(base, Vector3.new(500, 10, 500), platPos)
color(base, Color3.new(255, 0, 0.))
lock(base, true)

local floorPos = CFrame.new(0, -495, 0)
local floorF = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", floorPos, Workspace)
resize(floorF, Vector3.new(40, 0.5, 40), floorPos)
color(floorF, Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
lock(floorF, true)
createdecal(floorF, Enum.NormalId.Top)
setdecal(floorF, "131034375217479", Enum.NormalId.Top)

local function buatFoto(x, z, face, id)
    local cf = CFrame.new(x, -480, z)
    local f = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", cf, Workspace)
    resize(f, Vector3.new(1, 35, 30), cf)
    color(f, Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
    lock(f, true)
    createdecal(f, face)
    setdecal(f, id, face)
end

buatFoto(-35, 45, Enum.NormalId.Right, "91553675772893")
buatFoto(-35, -45, Enum.NormalId.Right, "127295578140184")
buatFoto(35, 45, Enum.NormalId.Left, "96073597459340")
buatFoto(35, -45, Enum.NormalId.Left, "73916685652770")

local skyPos = CFrame.new(0, -500, 0)
local skyPart = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", skyPos, Workspace)
makemesh(skyPart)
syncmeshid(skyPart, "108449640067150")
syncmeshtexture(skyPart, "108449640067150")
syncmeshsize(skyPart, Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999))
lock(skyPart, true)
setcollision(skyPart, false)

RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";res all")
wait(0.3)
RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";r6 all")
RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";time 14")
wait(0.7)
RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";music 87174269808530 ;pitch 0.1 ;volume 9 ;loop ;sm team 1x6xjxG Join Today!")
